with javascript_semantics

function selection_sort(sequence s)
    for i=1 to length(s) do
        integer m = i
        object si = s[i],
               sm = s[m]
        for j=i+1 to length(s) do
            object sj = s[j]
            if sj<sm then
                {sm,m} = {sj,j}
            end if
        end for
        if sm<si then -- (or equivalently m!=i)
            s[i] = sm
            s[m] = si
        end if
    end for
    return s
end function

?selection_sort(shuffle(tagset(10)))

macro evalwithx(expr, a, b)
    return quote
        x = $a
        tmp = $expr
        x = $b
        return $expr - tmp
    end
end

@evalwithx(2 ^ x, 3, 5)     # raw expression (AST)

import pyaudio

chunk = 1024
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 1
RATE = 44100

p = pyaudio.PyAudio()

stream = p.open(format = FORMAT,
                channels = CHANNELS,
                rate = RATE,
                input = True,
                frames_per_buffer = chunk)

data = stream.read(chunk)
print [ord(i) for i in data]
